about: House rule STORY_INTRO_OUTRO: every video, in both sizes, opens with an animated branded intro made for its own story, carries a designed audio treatment, and closes on an animated outro card made for that piece. Read by .agents/skills/produce-video, which stops before the final render while status is not "approved". Nothing here is designed yet: the designs go to Krish first (krish-design), and only his words approve one. A piece listed under "exceptions", with Krish's own quoted words, is the one case a cut is finished without them.

said.words: when the videos come back bear in mind that I want a proper animated branded intro to this specific story visually, the audio treatment, and then a proper animated outro card. Across all formats, and this should be part of the system moving forward.

required.story_intro: a proper animated, branded intro made for this specific story, in the 16:9 long cut and the 9:16 short cut
required.audio_treatment: the audio treatment that goes with it, across the intro, the voice and the outro
required.outro_card: a proper animated outro card made for this piece, in the 16:9 long cut and the 9:16 short cut

until_approved: story intro and outro not designed yet

approved.design: the stand-off (docs/plans/2026-10-12-story-io): apps/renderer/src/story StoryIntroStandoff and StoryOutroStandoff, rendered per piece by scripts/quick-edit/story_io.py
approved.words: This MUST go out with music, and now you have been such a twat, I am going to also insist todays video goes out with the new intro and outro animations too
approved.context: He ruled it in the same message that asked for the midday run to make every video; the design is the blind-judging winner, shown to him in the publish board with Monday's videos.
approved.revised: 2026-10-12: the real makeyourmindup wordmark and masthead in place of typed text, a calm 6 s outro that holds its last card 2 s, and eased transitions, on Krish's words: "the last frame is way too chaotic, doesn't last long enough and is completely the wrong brand mark"
